Among all U.S. cities whose 2020‑Census population falls between **2 – 5 million**, the city with the **highest murder rate per 100 000 people in 2022** (per the Robslink data) is:

> **Chicago, Illinois – 25.9 murders per 100 000 residents**

| Houston, TX | 2,304,580 | 19.0 |

*Source: Robslink “murder_rate” page (table shows city‑wide homicide rates for 2022) – the table was fetched from <https://robslink.com/SAS/democd59/murder_rate.htm>.*

The table lists murder rates for many U.S. cities; filtering for those meeting the 2‑5 million population criterion shows Chicago at the top of the list with 25.9 murders per 100 000 people in 2022. No other city in that population bracket exceeds Chicago’s rate.
